# Cross-cutting compliance capability — referenced by products, scenarios,
# and the process landscape. Diagram address H1 in the capability-map view.
# Schema: notations/views/05-capability-map.md §13 + CONTRACT.md §6–§7.

notation: capability
id: CAPABILITY-H1
name: "Compliance & Data Protection"
type: supporting
description: >
  Cross-cutting capability covering GDPR/NIS2 obligations: data-subject
  rights, breach reporting, and data residency. Lowest current maturity —
  the focus of the 2026 remediation programme.

business_process: PROCESS-DSR-HANDLE-1

admitted_by: "v.korobeinikov"
gate_checks:

  consistency: pass
  completeness: pass

valid_from: "2026-05-26"

notation: capability
id: CAPABILITY-V1.1
name: "Order Intake"
type: domain                            # domain | supporting
description: >
  Capture and validate customer order requests across all channels.
  Sits at the very top of the order-management value chain — touches
  the customer first, then hands off to the fulfilment side.

# Worked example — Capability element primitive (stable fields only).
# Schema: notations/views/05-capability-map.md §13 + admission record

# Time-varying attributes (current_maturity, owner_role, target_date) live

notation: capability
id: CAPABILITY-V1.2
name: "Order Fulfilment"
type: domain                            # domain | supporting
description: >
  Pick, pack, route, and close out customer orders. Sits beneath Order
  Management alongside Order Intake (CAPABILITY-V1.1).

# Admission record (CONTRACT.md §6)
zone: canon
admitted_at: "2026-05-29"
admitted_by: "v.korobeinikov"
gate_checks:
  uniqueness: pass
  consistency: pass
  completeness: pass

# Worked example — versioned-attribute sidecar.
# Schema: notations/CONTRACT.md §9.1.
#
# Target: the CAPABILITY-V1.yaml primitive in this folder. Time-varying
# attributes (current_maturity, target_maturity, owner_role, target_date)
# live here, not inline on the primitive. Four patterns demonstrated:
#   1. current_maturity — monotonic progression over three years.
#   2. owner_role       — handover from one role to another.
#   3. target_date      — re-aiming the planning target (moved earlier).
#
# Current-value resolution: pick the entry with the largest
# valid_from <= today (CONTRACT.md §9.2). Validation rules
# VERSIONED-001..005 apply.

target: CAPABILITY-V1

attribute_versions:

  # Maturity progression: the organisation lifted Order Management from
  # CMM 1 in 2024 to CMM 3 by late 2026 through sustained investment.
  current_maturity:
    - { valid_from: "2024-01-01", value: 1 }
    - { valid_from: "2025-06-01", value: 2 }
    - { valid_from: "2026-09-15", value: 3 }

  target_maturity:
    - { valid_from: "2024-01-01", value: 3 }

  # Owner-role handover when the Order Management team split out of
  # Operations into its own product unit.
  owner_role:
    - { valid_from: "2024-01-01", value: ROLE-OPS-1 }
    - { valid_from: "2026-07-01", value: ROLE-OPS-2 }

  # Planning target date — initially the org committed to CMM 3 by mid-
  # 2027; performance accelerated and the target was moved earlier.
  target_date:
    - { valid_from: "2024-01-01", value: "2027-06-30" }
    - { valid_from: "2026-04-01", value: "2026-12-31" }

# Worked example — Capability element primitive (stable fields only).

# NOT inline here. Inline placement would trigger VERSIONED-004.

notation: capability
id: CAPABILITY-V1
name: "Order Management"
type: domain                            # domain | supporting
description: >
  End-to-end management of customer orders, from intake through
  fulfilment. The capability spans receiving, validating, routing, and
  closing out customer purchase requests across all channels.

# Relations — stay inline in v1 (Wave 3 may promote to first-class
# time-aware relation files)
business_process: PROCESS-ORD-FULFILL-1
applications:
  - APPLICATION-OMS-1
  - APPLICATION-CRM-1

# Admission record (CONTRACT.md §6)
zone: canon
admitted_at: "2026-05-28"
admitted_by: "v.korobeinikov"
gate_checks:
  uniqueness: pass
  consistency: pass
  completeness: pass

# Primitive lifecycle (CONTRACT.md §7)
valid_from: "2024-01-01"
valid_to: null

# Worked example — first-class time-aware relation (the FIRST half of a
# re-parenting event). Schema: notations/elements/17-relations.md §2.
#
# Narrative: CAPABILITY-V1.1 (Order Intake) was originally introduced
# under CAPABILITY-V2 (Customer Relationship Management) in 2024 —
# the org modelled order intake as a customer-facing capability. In
# 2026-04, after an operational review, it was re-parented to V1
# (Order Management) where it fits better operationally. This REL
# file captures the OLD parent relationship; the new one is in
# REL-CAP-V11-PARENT-2.yaml.

notation: relation
id: REL-CAP-V11-PARENT-1
type: parent
from: CAPABILITY-V1.1
to: CAPABILITY-V2

# Admission record (CONTRACT.md §6)
zone: canon
admitted_at: "2026-05-28"
admitted_by: "v.korobeinikov"
gate_checks:
  uniqueness: pass
  consistency: pass
  completeness: pass

# Primitive lifecycle (CONTRACT.md §7) — this relation was in effect
# from V1.1's birth until the 2026-04 re-org closed it.
valid_from: "2024-01-01"
valid_to: "2026-04-01"

# Worked example — first-class time-aware relation (the SECOND half of
# a re-parenting event). Schema: notations/elements/17-relations.md §2.
#
# Narrative: after the 2026-04 operational review, CAPABILITY-V1.1
# (Order Intake) was re-parented from V2 (Customer Relationship
# Management) to V1 (Order Management). This REL file captures the
# NEW parent relationship. The previous relation is in
# REL-CAP-V11-PARENT-1.yaml (ended 2026-04-01).

notation: relation
id: REL-CAP-V11-PARENT-2
type: parent
from: CAPABILITY-V1.1
to: CAPABILITY-V1

# Admission record (CONTRACT.md §6)
zone: canon
admitted_at: "2026-05-28"
admitted_by: "v.korobeinikov"
gate_checks:
  uniqueness: pass
  consistency: pass
  completeness: pass

# Primitive lifecycle (CONTRACT.md §7) — this relation took effect on
# the same date the prior parent relation ended. valid_to: null means
# the relation is currently in effect.
valid_from: "2026-04-01"
valid_to: null

# Capability map — core domains plus the cross-cutting Compliance & Data
# Protection capability, with CMMI maturity overlay. Notation spec:
# notations/views/05-capability-map.md. Every inline capability (recursively)
# carries `type` and CONTRACT.md §7 lifecycle.

notation: capability-map
spec_version: "0.1"
title: "Acme Corp — Capability Map with Compliance Overlay"
description: "Core business capabilities and the cross-cutting compliance capability, with current and target CMMI maturity."
version: "1.0"
date: "2026-06-10"

capability_map:
  id: CAPABILITY_MAP-COMPLIANCE-1
  name: "Compliance-Domain Capability Map"
  description: "Business capabilities with current and target maturity, highlighting the data-protection gap."
  assessment_date: "2026-06-10"

  capabilities:
    - id: V1
      name: "Order Management"
      type: domain
      business_process: PROCESS-ORD-FULFILL-1
      applications:
        - APPLICATION-OMS-1
        - APPLICATION-CRM-1
      valid_from: "2026-05-26"
      valid_to: null
      children:
        - id: V1.1
          name: "Order Intake"
          type: domain
          valid_from: "2026-05-26"
          valid_to: null
        - id: V1.2
          name: "Order Fulfilment"
          type: domain
          valid_from: "2026-05-26"
          valid_to: null

    - id: V2
      name: "Customer Relationship Management"
      type: domain
      applications:
        - APPLICATION-CRM-1
      valid_from: "2026-05-26"
      valid_to: null

    - id: H1
      name: "Compliance & Data Protection"
      type: supporting
      description: >
        Cross-cutting capability covering GDPR/NIS2 obligations: data-subject
        rights, breach reporting, and data residency. Lowest current maturity —
        the focus of the 2026 remediation programme.
      business_process: PROCESS-DSR-HANDLE-1
      valid_from: "2026-05-26"
      valid_to: null
